Wildfire prevention
At Rocky Mountain Power, we're continuing to take steps to prevent wildfires.
You can also take action at home: Make a plan, create defensible space around your home, and prepare for your family's
needs in the event of an emergency. Consider a backup generator for your business or your home, especially if you have
medical equipment. Check your local emergency management or public safety website for more information on how to sign
up for alerts. Update your contact information with us and sign up to receive our alerts.
Learn more about what we're doing and how to prepare at RockyMountainPower.net/Wildfire.
Seguridad y preparación
En Rocky Mountain Power seguimos tomando medidas para prevenir los incendios forestales.
También puedes tomar medidas en casa: Haga un plan, cree un espacio defendible alrededor de su casa y prepárese para las
necesidades de su familia en caso de emergencia. Considere la posibilidad de instalar un generador de reserva en su negocio
o en su casa, sobre todo si tiene equipos médicos. Vea el sitio web de gestión de emergencias o seguridad pública de tu
localidad para obtener más información sobre cómo inscribirte para recibir alertas. Actualice su información de contacto con
nosotros y regístrese para recibir nuestras alertas.
Para más información sobre lo que estamos haciendo y cómo prepararse en RockyMountainPower.net/Wildfire.
Effective July 1, 2025, the Utah Public Service Commission approved an increase to the Energy Balance Account (Schedule
94) charge. This charge collects the difference between the estimated costs of power and the actual, incurred costs of power.
Your bill will reflect charges billed at old and new rates.

Effective July 1, 2025, Salt Lake County implemented a county option sales and use tax of 0.2% as allowed in Utah Code
59-12-2220. This tax is used to fund highways and public transit. Your bill reflects taxes for the portion of time rates were in
effect for your billing period.
When you provide a check as payment, you authorize us to use the information from your check either to make a one-time
electronic fund transfer from your account or to process the payment as a check transaction. When we use information from
your check to make an electronic fund transfer, funds may be withdrawn from your account as soon as we receive your pay-
ment and you will not receive your check back from your financial institution. If you would like to opt out of this program and
continue processing your payment as a check transaction, please call 1-800-895-0561. If you have opted out previously,
please disregard this message.
